purpose: Restrict the API runtime to revoking fixed-role grants without allowing scope or role mutation.
lockImpact: Changes table privileges only and does not rewrite fixed_role_grants rows.
dataImpact: No data changes; existing SELECT and INSERT privileges remain and UPDATE is limited to revoked_at.
recovery: Temporarily re-grant full UPDATE only through a reviewed emergency migration if an older runtime must be restored.
forwardFix: Append a reviewed authorization-owned migration. Do not rewrite this migration after application.
